title: Credits
intro: Little Meadow was made with free and open source software. Thank you to everyone who builds it.

items.name: Blender
items.detail: 3D modelling, rigging, animation and rendering, version 5.2.2 LTS

items.name: Blender add-ons used
items.detail: Rigify (rig generation) and Node Wrangler (node shortcuts), both GPL-2.0-or-later, and the glTF 2.0 importer and exporter (Apache-2.0). All three ship inside Blender

items.name: Godot Engine
items.detail: Game engine, version 4.7.2 stable. Copyright (c) 2014-present Godot Engine contributors. Copyright (c) 2007-2014 Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur. The exported game contains the engine, so its MIT permission notice (below) belongs with every copy of the game

items.name: Git
items.detail: Version control for the game project (optional tool, not part of the game)

items.name: Inter
items.detail: Body text of this book. Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors

items.name: DejaVu Sans Mono
items.detail: Code listings of this book. Copyright (c) 2003 Bitstream, Inc. DejaVu changes are in the public domain
items.license: Bitstream Vera and public domain licence

items.name: Nunito
items.detail: Text of the game's menus and HUD. Variable font by Vernon Adams, Cyreal and Jacques Le Bailly. Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors. The font file is unchanged and the licence text sits next to it in assets/fonts/OFL.txt

items.name: Little Meadow models, textures and scripts
items.detail: Made by the authors for this book. [FILL IN BEFORE RELEASE: the licence of the game models, textures and GDScript files. No licence file exists in the project yet]

items.name: Little Meadow Blender scripts
items.detail: The Python scripts of Chapters 9 to 20. [FILL IN BEFORE RELEASE: a licence that is compatible with the GPL of Blender]

items.name: Sound effects, ambience and music
items.detail: 26 sounds made for this book by tools/make_audio.py (numpy and scipy synthesis, ffmpeg libvorbis). No third-party samples. The authors dedicate the sounds to the public domain
